_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Configuration Item (CI) Documentation Recommendation
summary: Details the contractor's recommendations for designating items as CIs in the contract work breakdown structure and the types of configuration documentation used to identify CI configurations.
use_relationship:
The CI Documentation Recommendation details the development of contractor's recommendations for the designation of items as CIs in the contract work breakdown structure and its extensions, as well as the types of configuration documentation to be used to identify the configurations of CIs. The purpose of this data is to facilitate program management by further decomposition of the system architecture into logical components that will enhance systems engineering, integrated logistics support, and configuration management efforts. The data also provides the Government with technical rationale for selection of the most appropriate types(s) of configuration documentation to be used to describe the performance and physical requirements of CIs.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in EIA-649-1A and the principles of SAE/EIA-649C.

Copies of these standards are available online at https://www.sae.org or from SAE International, 400 Commonwealth Drive Warrendale, PA 15096-0001, Tel 877-606-7323 (inside USA and Canada) or 724-776-4970 (outside USA).

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81879 and DI-SESS-82007A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content:
The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract as cited in the current issue of the MIL-STD-963C Department of Defense, Data Item Description.

The following references may be useful in defining content: SAE/EIA-649C, Configuration Management Standard; (Copies of the SAE documents are available online at https://www.sae.org . Copies of the DOD document are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil) to provide additional direction/guidance for CIs.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The format shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The content shall include the following:

children.title: Recommendations supported by rationale
children.content: Recommendations supported by rationale, for designating elements of the contract work breakdown structure, and its extensions; as CIs; and for the most appropriate type(s) of configuration documentation to be used to identify the configuration of those CI's.
